title: fix(sessions): wire real context-% data into kimi and devin CLI rows
context:
Kimi and Devin CLI archive/list rows never set latest_input_tokens or
context_limit, so the sidebar's context-% chip silently disappeared for
every kimi/devin session even though the underlying token data existed.

- kimi: extend the existing incremental wire.jsonl scanner
  (_kimi_wire_lifetime_tokens -> _kimi_wire_usage_meta) to also track the
  latest context-window size (context.update_token_count, falling back to
  the last usage.record turn window), and stamp it + a context_limit onto
  ev
